card.name: Potassium terms and animal-study linking words
card.fires_on: Pieces of potassium-related words (IKr, hyperkalemia, antikaliuretic) and small linking words like "and", "or" or "in" between animal species in reproduction-study sentences.

modes.label: Potassium word pieces
modes.description: Partway through potassium-related terms such as IKr, hyperkalemia or antikaliuretic.
modes.example: Mifepristone and its metabolites block<< IK>>r.

modes.label: Linking word between animal species
modes.description: "and" or "or" after rats, before rabbits, in teratogenicity study statements.
modes.example: No teratogenic effects of enalapril were seen in studies of pregnant rats<< and>> rabbits.
